"MODEL:11n CardBus Adapter-7 (AR) A" and "REV: 1.1" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :The device is presumed to use AR5416 + AR2133. It is specified as a 2x3 device in the test report.
The Windows driver device description in the FCC manual is '''TP-LINK Wireless N Adapter'''.
[http://forum.ipfire.org/index.php?topic=2074.0 '''forum.ipfire.org''' post indicating the device uses the AR5416 PCI ID]
